title: Local Marketing Guide for Australian Businesses | Mailchimp

facts.fact: Mailchimp's page promotes a free 14-day trial, or 15% off for businesses with 10,000+ contacts (vendor's own offer).
facts.quote: Join Mailchimp with a free 14-day trial or save 15% off on 10,000+ contacts.

facts.fact: The article cites a 2025 report saying over 97% of people in Australia are online.
The article cites a 2025 report saying around 78% of people in Australia use social media.
The article states that nearly half of all searches have local intent, meaning customers are actively looking for nearby options.
facts.quote: Nearly half of all searches have local intent

facts.fact: The article states that around 68% of searches in Australia now happen on mobile devices.
facts.quote: Around 68% of searches in Australia now happen on mobile devices

facts.fact: The article states that 88% of customers check reviews before visiting a business.
The Mailchimp guide was posted on May 6, 2026.
The page defines local SEO marketing as the part of local online marketing that helps a business appear first when people search for a business near them, especially for high-intent queries.
facts.quote: When people search for a business near them, you want to show up first. That’s where local SEO marketing comes in. It’s a key part of local online marketing, especially for high-intent queries.

facts.fact: The page gives a hypothetical example of a Melbourne plumber creating service pages for the suburbs of Brunswick and Footscray and keeping an active Google profile to appear in 'near me' searches.
facts.quote: A Melbourne plumber creates service pages for Brunswick and Footscray, and maintains an active Google profile to appear in “near me” searches from those areas.

facts.fact: Mailchimp states that it may use cookies to keep customers signed into their Mailchimp account for 30 days unless they manually log out.
facts.quote: We may use cookies to keep customers signed into their Mailchimp account for 30 days, unless they manually log out
